sql.customer.getAllByCompany: select id, first_name, last_name, first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, email, phone, company_id from flow.customer where company_id = :companyId;
sql.customer.searchCustomers: select c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as full_name, c.email, c.phone, c.company_id, c.customer_type_id, ct.customer_type, c.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation, c.date_created, (select json_build_object( 'userId', u.id, 'firstName', u.first_name, 'lastName', u.last_name, 'fullName', u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name )) as owner from flow.customer c inner join flow.customer_type ct on ct.id = c.customer_type_id left join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = c.owner_user_position_id left join flow."user" u on u.id = up.user_id where case when :isParent then array[c.company_id] <@ ( select array(select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int))) else c.company_id = :companyId end and (c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR s.state ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' ) order by c.date_created desc limit :limit offset :offset ;
sql.customer.searchCustomerCount: select count(*) from flow.customer c inner join flow.customer_type ct on ct.id = c.customer_type_id left join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = c.owner_user_position_id left join flow."user" u on u.id = up.user_id where case when :isParent then array[c.company_id] <@ ( select array(select id from flow.company_hierarchy_filter_down(:parentCompanyId::int))) else c.company_id = :companyId end and (c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR s.state ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' )
sql.customer.exportCustomers: select c.first_name, c.last_name, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as full_name, c.street1, c.email, c.phone, c.company_id, c.city, c.postal_code, c.state_id, s.state, s.abbreviation, c.date_created, (select json_build_object( 'userId', u.id, 'firstName', u.first_name, 'lastName', u.last_name, 'fullName', u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name )) as owner from flow.customer c left join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id left join flow.user_position up on up.id = c.owner_user_position_id left join flow."user" u on u.id = up.user_id where c.company_id = :companyId and (c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' OR s.state ILIKE '%' || :query || '%' ) order by c.date_created desc;
sql.customer.getById: select c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.date_created, c.first_name || ' ' || c.last_name as full_name, c.email, c.phone, c.mobile, c.customer_type_id, c.company_id, c.street1, c.city, c.state_id, s.state, c.country_id, ct.country, c.owner_user_position_id, coalesce(( SELECT array_to_json(array_agg(row_to_json(projects))) FROM ( select p.id, p.project_name as "projectName" from flow.project p where p.customer_id = c.id ) projects), '[]') AS "projects", (SELECT row_to_json(o) FROM (SELECT u.id as "userId", u.first_name as "firstName", u.last_name as "lastName", u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name AS "fullName", p.position FROM blueraven."user" u inner join flow.user_position up on up.user_id = u.id inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id WHERE up.id = c.owner_user_position_id) o) AS owner from flow.customer c left join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id inner join flow.country ct on ct.id = c.country_id where c.id = :customerId
sql.customer.getCustomerCompanyId: select company_id from flow.customer where id = :primaryId
sql.customer.getByProjectId: select c.id, c.first_name, c.last_name, c.date_created, c.first_name || ' ' || last_name as full_name, c.email, c.phone, c.mobile, c.customer_type_id, c.company_id, c.street1, c.city, c.state_id, s.state, c.country_id, ct.country from flow.customer c inner join flow.project p on p.customer_id = c.id left join flow.state s on s.id = c.state_id inner join flow.country ct on ct.id = c.country_id where p.id = :projectId
sql.customer.updateCustomer: update flow.customer set customer_type_id = :customerTypeId, first_name = :firstName, last_name = :lastName, street1 = :street1, city = :city, state_id = :stateId, postal_code = :postalCode, country_id = :countryId, phone = :phone, email = :email, mobile = :mobile, modified_by_id = :modifiedById, date_modified = now(), owner_user_position_id = :ownerUserPositionId where id = :id
sql.customer.insertCustomer: insert into flow.customer(customer_type_id, first_name, last_name, street1, city, state_id, postal_code, country_id, phone, email, mobile, created_by_id, company_id) values (:customerTypeId, :firstName, :lastName, :street1, :city, :stateId, :postalCode, :countryId, :phone, :email, :mobile, :createdById, :companyId)
sql.customer.getOwners: select u.id as "userId", u.first_name, u.last_name, u.first_name || ' ' || u.last_name as full_name, up.id as user_position_id, p.position from flow.owner_position_id op inner join flow.user_position up on array[up.position_id] <@ op.position_ids inner join flow."user" u on u.id = up.user_id inner join flow.position p on p.id = up.position_id where op.company_id = :companyId and ARRAY[u.user_status_type_id] <@ ARRAY[ :statusIds ]::integer[] and up.start_date <= now() and (up.end_date is null or up.end_date >= now()) order by u.last_name, u.first_name
sql.customer.updateOwner: update flow.customer set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, owner_user_position_id = :ownerUserPositionId, date_modified = now() where id = :id
sql.customer.convertToCustomer: update flow.customer set modified_by_id = :modifiedById, customer_type_id = :customerTypeId, date_modified = now() where id = :customerId
